opex.name: Selling, general & administrative
opex.note: Warehouse labor, rent, utilities and head office.

follow100Note: Membership fees were only $1.87 of every $100 of revenue, yet they covered about 55% of Costco's operating profit — the membership model, not the markup, is where the money is.
footerNote: Costco's merchandise costs include buying, freight and shrink (lost or damaged goods) — the direct cost of what's on the shelves. The quarter is 12 weeks, ended November 26, 2023.

kpis.label: Comparable sales
kpis.note: total company; also +4% adjusted for fuel prices and currency

oneTimers: Income taxes included a $44M benefit ($0.10 per diluted share) related to stock-based compensation.
The year-ago quarter included a $93M pre-tax charge tied to charter shipping, which flatters this quarter's margin comparison by about 17 basis points.
otherDetail: Interest income and other of $160M, net, less $38M of interest expense.

segments.name: Net sales
segments.note: Everything sold in the warehouses and online — comparable sales rose 4% (U.S. +2%, Canada +6%, other international +11%), and e-commerce comparable sales rose 6%.

segments.name: Membership fees
segments.note: Annual fees from members — almost pure profit, since the warehouses would run anyway. Renewal rates in the U.S. and Canada were 92.8%.

takeaways.text: Comparable sales rose 4% — U.S. +2%, Canada +6% and other international +11% — and e-commerce comparable sales rose 6%. Net sales grew 6.1% to $56,717M, and the net-sales gross margin improved 43 basis points to 11.04%.
takeaways.title: Shoppers kept coming

takeaways.text: Membership fees rose 8.2% to $1,082M. They are just 1.9% of revenue, yet they alone cover about 55% of the quarter's $1,984M in operating income. Costco ended the quarter with 72.0M paid household members, 129.5M cardholders and 871 warehouses.
takeaways.title: Membership is the profit engine

takeaways.text: On December 13, 2023, Costco declared a special cash dividend of $15 per share — about $6.7B in total, payable January 12, 2024 — on top of its regular dividend. Net income was $1,589M, or $3.58 a share, up 16.6%.
takeaways.title: A $15 special dividend

verdict: Costco's revenue rose 6.2% to $57.8B as comparable sales grew 4%, and with $1.08B of nearly cost-free membership fees on top, earnings per share rose 16.6% to $3.58 — and Costco declared a $15-per-share special dividend.
